description: Source code for TCP upload functionality in the Zephyr network performance testing module, including functions for sending data, handling asynchronous uploads, and socket configuration.

methods.name: sendall
methods.description: Sends all data in buffer over socket, handling partial sends.

methods.name: tcp_upload
methods.description: Performs TCP upload by sending packets for a specified duration and collecting results.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_upload
methods.description: Sets up socket and initiates TCP upload process.

methods.name: tcp_upload_async_work
methods.description: Worker function for asynchronous TCP upload, invokes callback on start, finish, or error.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_upload_async
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous TCP upload session with callback.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_uploader_init
methods.description: Initializes the TCP uploader module, setting up work structure.
